I wrote the three-step flow to `./solution.tsx`. I couldn't run code here, so I haven't run or tested it.

- **Step indicator:** each step shows "Step N of 3" above its title. The titles are "Your details", "Your team" and "Confirm".
- **Step 1:** "Full name" and "Email" are both required. "Continue" shows "Enter your name." for an empty or whitespace-only name. It shows "Enter a valid email." when the email has no @. Each message sits next to its field, and the flow doesn't advance until both are fixed.
- **Step 2:** the three team options are radios, and "Solo" is preselected so exactly one is always chosen. "Back" and "Continue" move between steps, and your entries are kept when you go back.
- **Step 3:** it shows a summary of name, email and team, and an "I agree to the terms" checkbox
